rules.title: Azure Pipelines macOS 13 Ventura hosted image is retired
rules.summary: The macOS 13 Ventura hosted image was retired on 2025-12-04. The Microsoft-hosted agents page states that date, and the Azure DevOps blog lists the same full retiral date.

sources.title: Upcoming Updates for Azure Pipelines Agents Images

constraints: Change only Microsoft-hosted pool.vmImage labels. This retirement does not apply to self-hosted agents, Managed DevOps Pools, or VM scale sets.
The macOS 13 notice names macos-14, macos-15, or macos-latest. macos-14 has its own scheduled removal on 2026-11-02, so prefer macos-15 or macos-latest when the workload allows it.

steps.title: Retarget the hosted image
steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from macos-13 to macos-15 or macos-latest (the notice also allows macos-14; see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other Azure Pipelines pools
steps.instructions: Update every other azure-pipelines.yml pool, including stage and job pools, that still pins macos-13. Leave self-hosted pool names unchanged.

verification.purpose: Lint .gitlab-ci.yml with gitlab-ci-lint, or .circleci/config.yml with circleci config validate, when the repository has that file. Azure Pipelines has no equivalent local validator: queue the pipeline and confirm the job uses the replacement vmImage.

rules.title: Azure Pipelines macOS 14 Sonoma hosted image is scheduled for removal

constraints: Change only Microsoft-hosted pool.vmImage labels. The macOS 14 schedule does not apply to self-hosted macOS 14 agents.

steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from macos-14 to macos-latest or macos-15 (see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other Azure Pipelines pools
steps.instructions: Update every other azure-pipelines.yml pool, including stage and job pools, that still pins macos-14. Leave self-hosted pool names unchanged.

rules.title: Azure Pipelines Ubuntu 20.04 hosted image is retired
rules.summary: The Ubuntu 20.04 hosted image was fully removed on 2025-04-30, per the Azure DevOps blog deprecation plan. The Microsoft-hosted agents page lists that image as retired.

sources.title: Upcoming Updates for Azure Pipelines Agents Images

constraints: Change only Microsoft-hosted pool.vmImage labels. This removal does not apply to self-hosted Ubuntu 20.04 agents.
The Ubuntu 20.04 notice names ubuntu-22.04, ubuntu-24.04, or ubuntu-latest. ubuntu-22.04 is scheduled for removal on 2027-04-17, so prefer ubuntu-24.04 or ubuntu-latest when the workload allows it.

steps.title: Retarget the hosted image
steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from ubuntu-20.04 to ubuntu-24.04 or ubuntu-latest (the notice also allows ubuntu-22.04; see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other Azure Pipelines pools
steps.instructions: Update every other azure-pipelines.yml pool, including stage and job pools, that still pins ubuntu-20.04. Leave self-hosted pool names unchanged.

steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from ubuntu-22.04 to ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04, or ubuntu-26.04 (see the replacement).

rules.title: Azure Pipelines Windows Server 2019 hosted image is retired
rules.summary: The Windows Server 2019 hosted image was retired on 2025-12-31. The Azure DevOps blog sets that full removal date, and the Microsoft-hosted agents page records the same retirement.

sources.title: Upcoming Updates for Azure Pipelines Agents Images

constraints: Change only Microsoft-hosted pool.vmImage labels. This retirement does not apply to self-hosted Windows Server 2019 agents, Managed DevOps Pools, or VM scale sets.

The notice names windows-2022, windows-2025, or windows-latest. Pin windows-2022 or windows-2025 when the pipeline must stay on one Windows Server release, because windows-latest moves when Microsoft updates the alias.

steps.title: Retarget the hosted image
steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from windows-2019 to windows-2022, windows-2025, or windows-latest (see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other Azure Pipelines pools
steps.instructions: Update every other azure-pipelines.yml pool, including stage and job pools, that still pins windows-2019. Leave self-hosted pool names unchanged.

verification.purpose: Lint .gitlab-ci.yml with gitlab-ci-lint, or .circleci/config.yml with circleci config validate, when the repository has that file. Azure Pipelines has no equivalent local validator: queue the pipeline and confirm the job uses the replacement vmImage.
